verdict.rationale: Forter documents an automated dispute pipeline: chargebacks are ingested from the PSP via webhooks (e.g. Stripe), and a request-for-evidence webhook tells the merchant which evidence types to send. Merchants then push post-order evidence through an Evidence API, with no manual copy-paste, and order data plus fulfillment and shipping updates already flow in via the Order and Order Status APIs. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Forter itself compiles and submits the representment to the issuer, explicit mention of session/behavioral data being used as dispute evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow.
